- **Upton:** exact full-mask restoration conflicts are confined to BASIC **254809** against secondary source **12662**: 329 pair witnesses per world, 60 source facets across its four original bodies; the other five BASIC masks have no measured restoration conflicts. Job **04df198e74f3924c79a56129a9ec41036b2134d948daeb4e75596b48f6c4e883**, all **8,481** refs verified.
